dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Would you like to buy some flowers? I'm afraid you've come at a bad time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: A lot of the flowers in my shop were blown away by that huge wind from before.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Not only were the flowers on display outside blown away, but so were some that I had left near the storefront.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I still have a fair bit of stock, but the flowers put on display are the prettiest ones. A lot of customers are attracted by them.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Now, these flowers have been blown away, and I still need to clean up the store, so I won't be able to find time to pick new ones...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you're willing, could you help me pick some fresh flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Great! Still, you might need to pick quite a few...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Let me see... First, please help me pick one sweet flower and one small lamp grass from the Whispering Woods.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Then go to Windrise, and get me one windwheel aster.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Finally, help me pick a Cecilia from Starsnatch Cliff.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Please come back as soon as possible once you have them. If they wilt, they can't be displayed at the storefront.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I'm busy right now...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Alright then. I'll go get some myself once I can find the time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you like dandelions so much?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Hehe, I wonder... Maybe it's because I've been reading The Fox in the Dandelion Sea.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Here, take it. Maybe you'll like dandelions too once you finish reading it, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Welcome to Floral Whisper. Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: We carry a large variety of flowers. Are you looking for anything in particular?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: You need to go?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I'll tell you more about flowers next time if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Dandelions.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Dandelions are so very feathery. They are my personal favorite.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: The Acting Grand Master of the Knights is also known as the Dandelion Knight, as I recall.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: She probably learned the power of Anemo from the dandelions, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Sweet Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Sweet Flowers, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: They look nice, but most people just use them for cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: If you see people having Sweet Flowers in their gardens...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: They are probably used to get sugar.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Cecilias.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Cecilias! You've got good taste.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: They grow in cold and windy places. Legend has it that they only bloom when it's quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: If you wish to cultivate them...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: You'll probably have better luck with Mist Flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Craft</color>

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Use combine function

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy some flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Certainly. We have a fine selection, whether you're looking to give a bouquet to someone or even do some gardening yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I was honestly more frightened by the storm that surrounded Mondstadt than Stormterror.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Everyone's been focused on the losses to people and property, but I'm still more concerned about the plants and flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I'll protect them, just like how Lord Barbatos protects us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: It's great that I don't have to worry about the flowers in my store being blown away by the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: That said, the Dandelion Seeds have also been blown all across the region of Mondstadt by this storm. Who knows, perhaps they will bloom throughout the land.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: When I think about it like that, the storm doesn't seem so scary anymore, haha.
